We present a new problem KTRL+F (knowledge-augmented in-document search)... Given a natural language query and a long input document, KTRL+F is designed to fulfill three key criteria: (REQ 1) Find all semantic targets. (REQ 2) Utilizes external knowledge. (REQ 3) Operates in real-time.
